# Keyprint

> MIT-licensed Python toolkit for local text-watermarking experiments, paired generation and interactive recorded viewers. Community research preview; not a calibrated production detector or verified Anthropic reconstruction.

## Start
- [README](README.md): Installation, playground and comparison API.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): Repository map, focused checks and evidence boundaries.
- [Roadmap](ROADMAP.md): Available behavior, five contribution tracks and known failures.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): Local checks and backend validation.
- [Community](COMMUNITY.md): Demos, issues and AI-assisted contributions.

## Build
- [Examples](examples/README.md): Comparisons, galleries and prefix-data recipes.
- [Compatibility](COMPATIBILITY.md): Specific tested local model/client paths.
- [Provider clients](PROVIDERS.md): Local protocol subsets and retry limits.
- [Inference testing](INFERENCE_TESTING.md): Actual model execution and retained artifacts.
- [Output quality](OUTPUT_QUALITY.md): Language, meaning and factual-preservation boundaries.
- [Memory policy](MEMORY_SAFETY.md): Sequential, bounded local model work.

## Evidence
- [Release history](RELEASE_GOAL.md): Measurements and unresolved qualification gates.
- [Detection finding](evidence/paced-key-rank-2026-09-29/README.md): Weak current diagnostic, no calibrated detection claim.
- [Quality finding](evidence/paced-quality-2026-09-29/README.md): Retained factual/task failures in both arms.

Never reinterpret diagnostic fractions as AI-authorship probabilities. Do not rewrite, translate, repair or selectively retry outputs to make a demonstration look successful.

## Instant demos and complete guide

- [Recorded gallery](https://keyprint.vercel.app/play/): no-install public playback.
- [Demo source and remixing](demos/README.md): one-command model-free demo server.
- [Complete usage guide](USAGE.md): full setup, API and lifecycle details.
